name: Cirdingis (Chechen Meat and Dumplings)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: File:Cirdingis30.png|1. Make a "crater" in the middle of flour
File:Cirdingis32.png|2. Pour water into the well
File:Cirdingis35.png|3. Mix with hands to form a dough
File:Cirdingis36.png|4. Knead dough well until smooth
File:Cirdingis37.png|5. Add more flour if dough is too sticky
File:Cirdingis39.png|6. The finished dough should be smooth and not too sticky
File:Cirdingis40.png|7. Sprinkle work surface with flour
File:Cirdingis43.png|8. Cut dough into several pieces
File:Cirdingis45.png|9. Sprinkle a dish with flour
File:Cirdingis46.png|10. Place the dough pieces on the floured dish
File:Cirdingis48.png|11. Take a piece of dough and roll into a long rope
File:Cirdingis50.png|12. Flatten the dough rope slightly
File:Cirdingis52.png|13. Cut the rope into pieces
File:Cirdingis54.png|15. Toss the cut pieces with flour
File:Cirdingis57.png|17. Roll the pieces to about 2 inches long with your hands
File:Cirdingis60.png|18. Place the dough piece on floured surface
File:Cirdingis67.gif|22. Place the finished cirdingis on a platter
File:Cirdingis69.png|23. Boil a pot of water and add the cirdingis to cook
File:Cirdingis70.png|24. Strain out the cooked cirdingis
File:Cirdingis72.png|25. Serve cirdingis with sauces

culture.text: Cirdingis (pronounced as "jirdingish") is a traditional Chechen meal consisting of dumplings and meat served with accompanying sauces. It may also be called "galnish".
